4110051.title: Namhansanseong Autumn Festa: Fortress City in the Forest
4110051.overview: A season of hands-on programmes around Namhansanseong, the UNESCO-listed mountain fortress southeast of Seoul. Four strands run across the fortress grounds: traditional-culture workshops, an eco-history camp that explains the fortress ecology with guided walks and natural materials, a performance stage of theatre and Korean traditional music, and a Chuseok holiday special that lights the fortress with music after dark. Programmes run on different days and times, so check the schedule before you go. A good excuse to combine the fortress walk with something more than the view.

4114329.title: Heritage Media Art at the Cheorwon Workers' Party Headquarters
4114329.overview: A night-time media-art event at the bombed-out shell of the former Workers' Party headquarters in Cheorwon, one of the most striking Korean War ruins near the DMZ. Under the theme 'Peace Rising: from memory to empathy, from healing to the future', the building's facade becomes a screen for projection mapping, with interactive media, AR, light sculptures, AI-generated art and live performance around the adjacent history park. The centrepiece is 'Pro PACE: For Peace' by international media artist Yann Nguema, adapted to the site's history, alongside works drawn from Cheorwon's literature and residents' stories. Docent tours and special performances run during the event. Closed on Tuesdays and on Chuseok day (Sep 25).
4114329.place: Cheorwon Workers' Party Headquarters and Cheorwon History & Culture Park
4114329.sponsor: Korea Heritage Service, Gangwon State, Cheorwon County

4110067.title: Chilgok Transmedia Festival
4110067.overview: An arts festival spread across the everyday spaces of Waegwan, a small town in Chilgok County, North Gyeongsang. This fourth edition takes the friendship between the poet Gu Sang and the painter Lee Jung-seop as its theme, unfolding their lives and work through literature, art, media and performance. Rather than one festival ground, visitors follow a route through the town, meeting exhibitions, media installations, workshops and performances in sequence so that the spaces and content link into one experience. The information desk is at Waegwan Station. Closed Mondays.
4110067.place: Waegwan Station (information desk) and around Waegwan-eup

4109998.title: Ulsan Outdoor Library 'Picnic' at Seuldo
4109998.overview: An outdoor reading event with a sea view, held on Seuldo, a small islet on Ulsan's east coast. The city sets up an open-air library at the Seuldo Art space every Saturday and Sunday afternoon from 19 September to 18 October, ten sessions in all. Around the books there is busking, DJ sets and pan-flute performances, author talks, readings, a starlight docent and open-air film screenings including Little Forest, Kiki's Delivery Service and Ponyo. Line-ups and times can change with the weather. A relaxed way to spend a weekend afternoon by the water if you are in Ulsan.

3011178.title: Wonju Yongsugol Autumn Flower Festival
3011178.overview: A village-run flower festival in the Yongsugol valley outside Wonju, Gangwon. Residents plant and tend the fields themselves, and this fifth autumn edition runs for 13 days from 23 September to 5 October. Expect zinnias, sunflowers, cosmos, sulphur cosmos, verbena, globe amaranth and asters, laid out in blocks by colour and variety. The programme is mostly about walking the fields and taking photographs, with a small market of local food and farm produce. The same valley holds a poppy festival in spring. Last entry 17:00.

1328004.title: Yecheon Samgang Naru Tavern Festival
1328004.overview: A Chuseok-holiday festival built around Samgang Jumak, the last surviving traditional riverside tavern in Korea, in Yecheon, North Gyeongsang. For three days from 25 to 27 September the Samgang cultural complex fills with costumed actors playing the pedlars, tavern keepers, hunters and merchants who once rested here on the river crossing. Join the pedlars' market square, quizzes about Samgang history, a slow-mail post box, and hands-on activities such as dalgona candy, shooting, spinning and hanbok. Local artists, buskers and children's shows perform, and a market sells regional produce, crafts and food.

2505140.title: Yangju Globe Amaranth Autumn Festa
2505140.overview: Nari Farm in Yangju, north of Seoul, plants seven colours of globe amaranth and more than twenty other autumn flowers, and opens the fields to visitors from 18 September. The festival itself runs on weekends from 26 September to 4 October under the slogan 'Yangju's autumn, dyed in globe amaranth', with performances, hands-on activities and photo spots scattered through the fields. The farm sits in the middle of northern Gyeonggi, about an hour from most of the Seoul area, and is one of the region's best-known autumn day trips.

2988303.title: Yeongcheon Korean Medicine Festival
2988303.overview: The 24th edition of a festival devoted to traditional Korean medicine, held from 2 to 4 October along the riverside park in Yeongcheon, a town long known for its herbal medicine market. Zones cover health consultations with Korean-medicine doctors, K-MEDI wellness programmes, a herbal medicine market, medicinal food and a herbal picnic garden. Try herbal teas, make a herb sachet, sample skin and beauty treatments, or join family craft sessions. A mission tour with small gifts links the zones together. Free entry; food is sold separately.
2988303.place: Yeongcheon Riverside Park, Zone D (towards the Yeongcheon Cultural Center)

4113086.title: Wonju Small Business Products Fair
4113086.overview: A downtown street fair in Wonju that showcases products from local small manufacturers, held from 2 to 4 October at Youth Square. Alongside sales booths there are free hands-on stalls, a flea market, food trucks, a kids' zone and a main stage. Activities include sesame-candy making, mug, mother-of-pearl box and terrarium crafts, drone simulators, a cooking contest, quiz games and a children's talent show. It is a local community event rather than a tourist draw, but easy to drop into if you are passing through Wonju.

2969832.title: Jeonju International Picture Book Fair
2969832.overview: Korea's main festival for picture books, where original artwork by Korean and international illustrators is shown up close. Each year a guest country is invited; the fifth edition features Taiwan's Jimmy Liao alongside Korea's Kim Dong-seong, under the theme 'Picturing the Memories'. The fair runs from 2 to 4 October at the Sori Arts Center exhibition hall in Jeonju, with author talks, a book market of publishers, a showcase of emerging local illustrators, performances, workshops and a conference. The original-artwork exhibition then stays open until 25 October. Free entry.
2969832.place: Sori Arts Center of Jeollabuk-do, exhibition hall

4113071.title: Mungyeong Gaeun Ajagae Market Festival
4113071.overview: A three-day market festival from 2 to 4 October in Gaeun, a former coal-mining town in Mungyeong, built around the friendly atmosphere of the Ajagae traditional market. The opening night brings a gala show from the trot singing contest Miss Trot 4, Saturday is a 'time capsule' concert of singers from the 80s and 90s, and Sunday is a children's big show for families. A receipt event lets you sample dishes by well-known chefs using Mungyeong's medicinal-stone pork. A photo exhibition on Gaeun's mining history shows the miners and pit villages that powered Korea's industrialisation.

3372852.title: Buan Gomso Salted Seafood & King Prawn Festival
3372852.overview: Buan's main seafood festival, now in its 18th year, celebrates the salted seafood (jeotgal) of Gomso Bay and the autumn king prawn season. Gomso jeotgal is a traditional food made with sea salt from the bay's own salt flats, and dozens of varieties can be tasted and bought in one place. Stalls sell and serve prawns and other local catch, with tasting sessions and visitor programmes. It is a food-first festival on the west coast of North Jeolla, best combined with the nearby Byeonsanbando coast.

4114185.title: Gwangju Gastronomy Week
4114185.overview: A ten-day food festival, 2 to 11 October, that turns Gwangju's rich food culture into things you can actually do. Master cooks and artisans, young chefs reinterpreting regional dishes, and sustainability-minded food activists all take part. The opening is held at Ogaheon, a traditional hanok. A discount week run with Blue Ribbon Survey, Korea's leading restaurant guide, offers deals at vetted restaurants across the city, and 'Yangnim Spoon Week' spotlights eateries in the historic Yangnim-dong neighbourhood. Sustainable-dining events, including a vegan food trail, add a 'see, eat, learn' strand. A promotional booth runs at the Asia Culture Center during Asia Culture Week.
4114185.place: Asia Culture Center and venues across Gwangju

1398149.title: Samnangseong Historical & Cultural Festival
1398149.overview: Samnangseong is the fortress wall around Jeondeungsa Temple on Ganghwa Island, said by legend to have been built by the three sons of Dangun. The site later served as a base of resistance against the Mongols, kept the Annals of the Joseon Dynasty for 250 years, and saw the repulse of French troops in 1866 and a week-long militia victory against Japan in the late 1800s. The festival, now in its 26th year, begins on the first Saturday of October and mixes history with performances in the temple grounds; an autumn concert on 3 October runs until 21:00. Entry is free; parking is charged.
1398149.fee: Free (parking 4,000 won for cars, 8,000 won for coaches)
1398149.sponsor: Samnangseong Historical & Cultural Festival Organising Committee

3019872.title: Youth Mic Festival
3019872.overview: A one-day outdoor festival of young performers at Noryangjin football ground in Seoul, run by the Ministry of Culture's I.M. Youth Mic programme, which sends emerging artists to play in everyday spaces around the capital region and Gangwon. The festival version scales that up: a full day of stage performances, hands-on activities, food trucks, a flea market and on-site events. Free.
3019872.sponsor: Ministry of Culture, Sports and Tourism

1846905.title: Dalseong 100 Pianos
1846905.overview: In March 1900 the first piano in Korea arrived by river at Samunjin ferry landing in Dalseong, near Daegu, brought by the American missionary Richard Sidebotham; locals reportedly called it the 'ghost box'. That single instrument is the origin of this open-air concert, in which 100 pianos are played together on a stage by the Nakdong River. Started in 2012, the event ranges from classical to jazz and pop, and there is nothing else quite like it in the country. Performances are in the evening at the permanent outdoor stage at Samunjin.

3530974.title: Hobeop Cosmos Flower Festival
3530974.overview: A two-day autumn festival on 3 and 4 October along the cosmos path beside the Bokhacheon stream in Hobeop, Icheon. The first morning opens with a group walk along the cosmos path, followed by an afternoon 'Youth Up' stage; the second afternoon brings a cross-generation quiz show. Throughout, there is a photo and video exhibition, a 'flower-gazing' rest area for sitting among the blooms, and hands-on activities for all ages. A gentle countryside outing an hour or so from Seoul.
3530974.place: Hobeop Leisure Sports Park and the Bokhacheon cosmos path

3542109.title: Bungnae Geumdangcheon Three-Flavour Food Festival
3542109.overview: A small-town food festival in Bungnae, Yeoju, held along the Geumdangcheon stream. Local food stalls serve the area's specialities, farmers sell fresh produce, and there is a free pastry tasting and hands-on activities for all ages. The opening ceremony features a 40-piece orchestra, with performances continuing across the festival. It is a community event meant to bring life back to the local shopping street, so expect a homely atmosphere rather than a big production.
3542109.place: Streets in front of Bungnae-myeon Community Center

3514928.title: Korean Dream Hangang Festival
3514928.overview: A large open-air event on the Han River at Ttukseom that approaches Korean unification through culture rather than politics. The day mixes booths and hands-on activities with music, performances and a fireworks show, aimed at both younger and older audiences. Held since 2015 at venues including Seoul World Cup Stadium, the National Assembly lawn and Imjingak, it has run on the Han River under the Korean Dream name since August 2025; this is the second consecutive year here. Free, at the waterside stage in Ttukseom Hangang Park.
3514928.sponsor: 2026 Korean Dream Hangang Festival Organising Committee

4110074.title: Wangsaeng-ro Light Street Festival
4110074.overview: A two-night light festival on 3 and 4 October along Wangsaeng-ro, a busy street in Ulsan's Nam-gu, and its cultural park. The street is dressed with projection mapping, tree light shows, laser 'fireflies' and a giant mirror ball, with a stage line-up that includes singers Min Kyung-hoon and Sohyang plus DJs, buskers and street theatre. A food zone, beer park, flea market and hands-on activities keep the crowd on the street into the night. Free.
4110074.place: Wangsaeng-ro and Wangsaeng-ro Cultural Park, Nam-gu

3543595.title: Korea Joayong Festival
3543595.overview: Yongin's city mascot, a friendly dragon called Joayong, gets its own festival on 3 and 4 October at Yongin Mir Stadium, marking the 31st Citizens' Day and 30 years since Yongin became a city. There is a Joayong parade and a cosplay contest, and popular mascots from cities across Korea gather in one place. Linked events run alongside: a cyber science festival, a lifelong-learning fair, a youth festival, food festas and a food-industry expo. Family-friendly, with performances through both days. Free.

4112672.title: D.FESTA Small Theatre Festival
4112672.overview: Twenty years old this year, D.FESTA is Daehangno's festival of experimental small-theatre work, staged at Space Aul in Seoul's theatre district. It has grown from a Seoul event into a network that alternates between regional cities and, increasingly, Asian partners: this edition presents co-created work with companies from Sapporo, Tokyo, China and Taiwan and the results of a 'Small Theatre Festival in Tokyo'. Performances are mostly in Korean. Weekday shows at 19:30, weekend matinees; times vary by production, so check the programme. Early-bird and student tickets are half price.
4112672.fee: 30,000 won (early-bird until Sep 30 and students 15,000 won; other discounts with ID)
4112672.hours: Weekdays 19:30 · Sat 16:00 and 18:00 · Sun 15:00 and 17:00 (varies by production)

2666388.title: Children Are Happiness, Season 9
2666388.overview: A free family day on the lawn of Lotte World Park at Jamsil, organised by the Chosun Ilbo newspaper to promote child-friendly society. The site is mostly free activity booths for children, with a main stage of shows including the popular animated character Teenieping and magic acts. There are photo zones and shaded cabana and tepee rest areas. Register online in advance or at the entrance; participation is free.
2666388.place: Lotte World Tower World Park lawn

2989642.title: K-Military Festival: Battle of Chuncheon, 76th Anniversary
2989642.overview: The army's II Corps and Chuncheon City mark the Battle of Chuncheon, fought in the opening days of the Korean War, with a three-day festival from 9 to 11 October at the city's waterside park. Alongside the commemoration there are performances and exhibitions, military-equipment displays you can climb on, and public participation programmes, pitched at families. Free.

4111666.title: Cheonan Book Festival
4111666.overview: Cheonan's library-led book festival, held in the sunken plaza of Samgeori Park with libraries, reading clubs, bookshops and publishers taking part. The programme includes author meetings, family musicals and ensemble performances, an open-air library for reading in the autumn sun, sixteen activity booths and thirteen bookshop and publisher stalls. Authors of the city's 'books of the year' appear. Free, and mostly in Korean.

3113045.title: Paju Fair: Book & Culture
3113045.overview: Paju Book City, the publishing district north of Seoul, opens up for about ten days of book culture. Some 290 publishers and bookshops run a book market, with a themed exhibition and side programmes. The opening 'BOOKS ALIVE!' is followed by indie music and dance festivals, a brewery concert, listening sessions and 'book-nic' picnic rentals. Talks, flea markets and a global publishing and IP business forum spread across the district. The Asia Publication Culture & Information Center is the hub. Free, with some paid programmes.
3113045.place: Asia Publication Culture & Information Center and Paju Book City

1373481.title: Heungbu Festival
1373481.overview: Namwon in North Jeolla is the setting of the classic tale of Heungbu, the kind younger brother rewarded by a swallow with a gourd full of treasure, and the city's Heungbu Festival is one of the region's oldest folk festivals, now in its 34th year. It runs from 9 to 11 October at Gwanghallu Garden, the pavilion garden at the heart of town. Highlights include a recreated Heungbu homestead market, thatched stalls of Jirisan farm produce, a K-food street, a 'golden gourd' event where gourds six to eight metres tall are cracked open, Joseon-era job experiences, a performance retelling the 1597 Battle of Namwon, changgeuk opera of the Heungbu tale, a farmers' music contest and traditional wedding demonstrations.

4114312.title: Gangneung Bread Festival at Ojuk Hanok Village
4114312.overview: Gangneung's bakeries set up in the quiet hanok village beside Ojukheon for three days from 9 to 11 October. Local bakers sell and show their breads, there are hands-on sessions, performances and events for all ages, and plenty of spots for photographs among the traditional houses. The theme is 'a lap of the hanok village, following the smell of bread'. Gangneung is better known abroad for coffee; this is the bread version. Free entry.

4113826.title: Jinan Highland Forestival
4113826.overview: A forest festival and non-competitive trail run on 10 and 11 October at the National Jinan Highland Forest Healing Center in North Jeolla. Two courses are offered: 16K (16.9 km, over 1,071 m of climbing, six-hour limit) and 6K (6 km, 315 m of climbing, three-hour limit), each capped at 500 runners per day. Entry includes supplies and a T-shirt. Around the run are forest-healing sessions, forest culture activities and a local market. Organised by the Korea Forest Service, Jeonbuk State and Jinan County.
4113826.place: National Jinan Highland Forest Healing Center
4113826.fee: Trail run 30,000 won (6K) / 50,000 won (16K); activities 10,000–15,000 won
4113826.sponsor: Korea Forest Service, Jeonbuk State, Jinan County

2757751.title: Jeonju Street Puppet Festival
2757751.overview: The sixth edition of a puppet-theatre festival staged outdoors in Jeonju Hanok Village, at the Omokdae traditional garden and the puppet-theatre experience hall. Aimed at children and families but easy for hanok-village visitors to wander into, it presents puppet shows and hands-on puppet activities through the afternoon. Free.
2757751.place: Omokdae Traditional Garden and Puppet Theatre Experience Hall, Jeonju Hanok Village

3343831.title: Korea AI Content Awards
3343831.overview: Gyeonggi Province's awards and screening event for video made with generative AI, held on 15 and 16 October at Lotte Cinema Suwon. Entries from Korea and abroad are shown on the big screen, with Q&A sessions with the creators, an industry forum on AI and content, and an awards ceremony. A pop-up store and participatory content let general audiences try AI tools. Free.

2856938.title: Busan Craft Beer Masters Challenge
2856938.overview: A city craft-beer festival on the North Port waterfront in Busan, bringing breweries from across Korea together with the city's own. The core event is the Masters Challenge, a judged competition from heats to final, but for visitors it is mainly a beer market of brewery flagships, hop and malt tastings, brew-your-own and glass-decorating sessions, food pairings, busking and DJ sets. Evenings turn into a 'beer night' with music. Free entry; beer is paid.
2856938.sponsor: Busan Metropolitan City, Busan Economic Promotion Agency

2618530.title: Yangjae Flower Festa
2618530.overview: A flower-culture festival from 16 to 18 October around Yangjae Flower Market, Seoul's wholesale flower market, in the Star Friends garden of Citizens' Forest park. New varieties of roses, spray chrysanthemums, gerberas, lisianthus and moth orchids are showcased alongside florist displays. One-day classes, children's florist and horticultural-therapy job experiences, flower painting and a flower talk concert run through the day, plus a pressed-flower workshop that rescues blooms that would otherwise be discarded, a stamp tour and social-media events. Free.
2618530.place: Star Friends Garden, Maeheon Citizens' Forest
2618530.sponsor: Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs

2952759.title: Uicheon Riverside Festa 2026: Wellness in Wonderland
2952759.overview: A riverside lifestyle festival along the Uicheon stream, which flows down from Bukhansan through Seoul's Gangbuk district. Move along the water between the Uigyo and Ssanghan bridges to find performances, wellness programmes, art and the local shops that line the banks. Fees vary by programme; most of the atmosphere is free.

2488793.title: Seoul Urban Agriculture Expo
2488793.overview: The 15th Seoul Urban Agriculture Expo takes over the eastern leisure centre area of Seoul Forest for two days, 16 and 17 October, under the slogan 'Houseplants, a green comma for my mind'. Five zones cover the theme, promotion, hands-on activities, urban-farming lifestyle displays and a show of allotment crops. Activities include threshing grain and packing eggs in straw, insects, makgeolli brewing and grasshopper catching. Free.
2488793.place: Around the East Leisure Center, Seoul Forest

2770434.title: Daejeon Bread Festival
2770434.overview: Daejeon's bakery scene, famous nationwide for Sungsimdang, gets a festival of its own at Expo Science Park beneath the Hanbit Tower. Around 120 local bakeries take part, from the household names to neighbourhood shops, selling freshly baked bread through the afternoon and evening. The festival is as much about supporting small bakers and the old downtown as it is about eating, and it has become one of the city's signature fun events. Go early: popular stalls sell out. Free entry.
2770434.place: Around Hanbit Tower, Expo Science Park

4113301.title: Lucky's Mysterious Picnic on Dotseom Island
4113301.overview: A mission-tour game on Dotseom, the small island resort in Masan Bay, Changwon, styled as a 1980s–90s company outing. Register at the information desk, get your team item, and follow clues on the web platform Trace247 around the island to solve the final mission. Around it are a free retro picnic zone on the lawn, three free orienteering courses, a paid yacht experience on 24 and 25 October, a 'mysterious' snack shop, hanbok try-ons and small concerts arranged by the city. The island is reached by a short ferry; the fare is discounted during the event.
4113301.fee: Free entry · Ferry 9,000 won (event price) · Mission tour 5,000 won · Yacht 15,000 won (Oct 24–25 only)
4113301.sponsor: Korea Tourism Organization Busan-Ulsan-Gyeongnam Office, Changwon City

1718508.title: Soyanggang Cultural Festival
1718508.overview: Chuncheon's long-running local culture festival, now in its 47th year, held on 17 and 18 October in the city hall square. It stages the city's own traditions, including a dragon-spirit shamanic rite and a re-enacted communal fishing game from the Udu plain, alongside a street parade, community-class performances, youth stages, folk-arts troupes and guest acts. Visitors can join random-play dance, folk games, rice-cake pounding and craft sessions. Free.

4115096.title: Run Busan: Lucky Capsule Run
4115096.overview: A game-style fun run for all ages along the Oncheoncheon stream in Busan. The course is a 5 km out-and-back from the artificial waterfall at Dongnae Station, with a capsule to open and a mission to complete at every kilometre. Performances, games and a flea market run alongside. Free.
4115096.place: Oncheoncheon Citizens' Park (artificial waterfall, Dongnae Station)

4111479.title: Chudo Island Film Festival
4111479.overview: A three-day residential film festival on Chudo, a small island off Tongyeong on the south coast, made with the island's residents. Films shot by directors during residencies on the island are screened with shorts and features on the themes of longing and nature, at an open-air cinema by the night sea and indoors. Between screenings there is a storytelling trek with islanders, a sunset dinner of seasonal seafood and Q&As with filmmakers. The 100,000 won fee covers meals and accommodation on the island for the weekend of 23 to 25 October.
4111479.place: Mijo Outdoor Theatre and Community Center, Chudo Island

2857763.title: Seoul Music Festival
2857763.overview: A free city-run music festival on Nodeul Island in the Han River, curated this year in partnership with the Korean Music Awards. The line-up mixes award-winning and nominated artists with popular mainstream acts, new musicians and veteran legends, with the aim of connecting different generations and tastes in one place. Runs from midday into the evening on the island's outdoor stages; a good free option if you are in Seoul that weekend.

3019085.title: Icheon Pet Festival
3019085.overview: A weekend for dogs and their people on 24 and 25 October at Icheon Ceramic Art Village (Yespark). Activities you can do with your pet, a flea market and community programmes fill the village, and the artists' own 'autumn art walk' event runs at the same time, so the pottery studios and galleries are open too. Free.

3359994.title: Korea Maritime Mobility & Safety Expo
3359994.overview: An industry expo on future ships, autonomous navigation and marine safety at Busan's North Port, with a public side programme designed to make sea safety fun. Try an AI photo zone, decorate and wear a life jacket for a runway, learn CPR, put on a coast guard uniform, steer a ship in a simulator, or go through a man-overboard and ferry-emergency scenario in VR. Demonstrations show how life rafts and jackets really work. A stamp tour links the BPEX exhibition hall and the waterfront park. Free.
3359994.place: North Port Waterfront Park multi-purpose hall / BPEX event hall
3359994.sponsor: Ministry of Oceans and Fisheries, Busan Metropolitan City

2992829.title: K-Sports Festival Busan 2026
2992829.overview: A multi-sport festival that combines competitions, an expo, a conference and side events, open to elite athletes, amateurs and anyone interested in sport. It bills itself as Korea's only multi-discipline sports festival for everyone. Note that despite the Busan name, the listed venue is EXCO in Daegu; check the official site before travelling. Day pass 50,000 won, two-day pass 90,000 won.

637693.title: Masan Gagopa Chrysanthemum Festival
637693.overview: Masan was the birthplace of commercial chrysanthemum growing in Korea, where six farms began cultivation in 1961 and the first exports to Japan left in 1972. The city's chrysanthemum festival, held since 2000 and now in its 26th year, fills the 3.15 Marine Park, Happo waterside park and the new marine city with massed displays, bonsai chrysanthemums and floral sculptures against the harbour. Evenings bring a multimedia fireworks show, a traditional 'falling flower' fire display over the water, a singing contest, indie music and local performers, with food stalls throughout. Open until 22:00 and free.
637693.place: 3.15 Marine Park, Happo Waterside Park and Marine New Town, Masan

4114621.title: Korea Jeju Garden Culture Expo
4114621.overview: Jeju's first garden expo, held for five days from 6 to 10 November at Barammoru Park in the Jeju Innovation City, Seogwipo, under the slogan 'the breath of wind between stone walls, blooming into gardens'. Show gardens from the Korea Garden Show competition on the theme 'Jeju's breath: earth, stone, wind, K-garden' sit alongside participant, citizen and corporate gardens. Concerts, garden talks and hands-on zones run daily, and a garden market sells plants and tools. Tours to private gardens around the island are organised in parallel. Free.
4114621.sponsor: Korea Forest Service, Jeju Special Self-Governing Province, Seogwipo City

4111594.title: Yeongdeungpo Book Festa: Book Club for Today
4111594.overview: The first Yeongdeungpo Book Festa turns Mullae Neighbourhood Park into an open-air library for a few days, in partnership with the Seoul Outdoor Library brand. Library booths run hands-on programmes, a reading zone offers free reading on the grass, author talks bring writers and readers together, and a 'book-gazing' area is set aside for quiet rest. Free.

2736064.title: Gimje Heritage Night Walk
2736064.overview: A heritage night event at the Joseon-era county office and Confucian school in Gimje, North Jeolla, one of the national 'Heritage Night' series. Eight themed 'night' programmes reinterpret the site's history through performance, hands-on activities, exhibitions and night lighting, including a magistrate's procession, traditional-culture workshops, guided history talks, evening performances and tie-ins with the traditional market. Entry is free; food stalls, the flea market and some activities are paid.
2736064.place: Historic Site: Gimje County Office and Confucian School
2736064.fee: Free entry (food, flea market and some activities charged)

4110583.title: Sangju Citizens' Green Bicycle Parade
4110583.overview: Sangju calls itself Korea's bicycle city, and its 16th green bicycle parade rides about 9.4 km through the town and surrounding countryside from Bukcheon Citizens' Park. Anyone can join, with a stage show and activity programmes at the park. A morning event; free.
4110583.place: Outdoor concert hall, Bukcheon Citizens' Park

3541003.title: Gangnam Youth Festival
3541003.overview: A wellness and social festival for young adults at Gangnam Square by Gangnam Station. Programmes include a sauna bus and cold plunge, exercise sessions, one-day classes and participatory booths, with DJ sets and busking on stage. It is designed so that people who come alone can join in easily. Free.
